```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(ggfortify)
library(FactoMineR)
library(ggrepel)
```

# Load data

```{r}
load("../data/figure-data/desres_rberry.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/pca_rberry.rda")
```

# PCA

```{r}
PCA_label_plot <- 
  autoplot(rber.pca$PCA, data = rber.pca$GroupLabs, colour = "GroupID", label = FALSE, label.size = 3, shape = TRUE, frame = TRUE, frame.type = "convex") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme(
  axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 8.8), 
  legend.title = element_blank(), 
  legend.key.size = unit(0.75, "lines")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 0.5), ylim = c(-0.5, 1))

print(PCA_label_plot)

ggsave(plot = PCA_label_plot, "../figures/pca_rberry.png")

ggsave("../figures/Fig1B.svg", height= 1.75, width= 3.1)

```

# Volcano

```{r}
rber.desres %>%
  mutate(Tax.Sig=ifelse(padj < .05,TaxLev, NA),
        class.dum = ifelse(padj < 0.05, Taxa, NA),
        class.smart = if_else(grepl("g_uncl|sensu", class.dum),
                           true = NA,
                           false = class.dum),
        class.smart = str_replace(class.smart, 
                                  pattern = "_",
                                  replacement = " ")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange,
             y=-log(padj),
             color=Tax.Sig,
             label = class.smart)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05),
             color="red",
              linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.75) +   
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-4,4),
             color="red",
              linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.75) + 
  guides(color=guide_legend("Taxonomic\nRank")) + 
  geom_text_repel(show.legend = FALSE, size = 6.25) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Dark2",
                     na.value="gray50",
                     breaks=c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus")) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.97, 0.05),
        legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
        legend.box.just = "right",
        legend.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.box.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5) ,
        legend.key.width = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
   xlim(-8, 8)

ggsave("../figures/Fig1C.volcano.svg",
       height = 5,
       width = 7)
```
# LDA

```{r}
brb.sig <-
  rber.desres %>%
  filter(padj < .05) 


brb.sig %>% 
  mutate(Taxa = gsub("_", " ", gsub("g_", "", Taxa))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange,
             y=reorder(Taxa,log2FoldChange),
             fill=TaxLev)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) + 
  ggtitle("") +
  ylab("") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2",
                    breaks=c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus")) +
  labs(fill = "Taxonomic\nRank") +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = c(0.05, 0.95), 
        legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.box.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "cm")) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.75, 0.75)))  


ggsave("../figures/Fig1D.effecti-size_rberry-mics.svg",
       height = 5,
       width = 7)
```
